identity.title: Multi-Category Hermes Alpha Hunter: Source-Backed Probability, After-Cost Ranking and Budgeted Controlled Research (Research Only)
identity.objective: One finite foreground operator that discovers NBA moneyline and US daily-rain markets, derives independent source-backed probabilities with explicit uncertainty (ESPN predictor; NWS gridpoint PoP Frechet bounds), checks public venue identity, rule, tick, minimum, depth and fee, computes an estimated after-cost margin for a fixed research quantity, ranks research candidates deterministically with an exact denominator funnel, optionally runs budget-capped controlled Hermes research (default zero budget) and records immutable lineage in the existing PIT store and Alpha Factory registry. Research only: no strategy version, Gate C permit, order, credential or capital authority; valid NO_TRADE preserved.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert the eight scoped files, including only the A4 historical D005 presence-count assertion correction; merged shadow operator, controller, Alpha Factory, discovery, execution feasibility and all protected sources are untouched; scratch outputs live outside the checkout and Alpha records are append-only research memory.

api_matrix.reason: One new foreground tools operator composing merged native research, venue and Hermes seams; no new canonical library API.
